changelog: Record a labeled phone-tree pack of welcome, menu, hold, transfer, after-hours, and error prompts.

en.description: Build a labeled IVR voice pack for a phone tree: welcome, menu, hold, transfer, after-hours, and error prompts in one consistent brand voice. This phone tree voice studio and hotline voiceover shop records about twelve default prompts as a voice menu you can drop into the switch. Use it for IVR prompts, call center voice, auto attendant audio, and customer-service phone menus.
en.summary: Build a labeled IVR voice pack for a phone tree: welcome, menu, hold, transfer, after-hours, and error prompts in one consistent brand voice.
en.title: IVR Voice Pack: Labeled Phone-Tree Prompts
